name: Privi Anchor
tagline: Prove a file existed, without showing it to anyone.
intro: Fingerprint files on your device, anchor them on the Base blockchain, and get a certificate you can hand to someone else. One anchor can cover a whole folder.

key.label: Anchor API key
key.help: Privi Anchor is a paid service. Your API key is kept in this browser only.

features.title: Anchor a file
features.blurb: Put one or more fingerprints on chain.

features.title: Folder Manifest
features.blurb: Anchor up to 2,000 files at once; prove any one later.

features.title: Certificate
features.blurb: A readable proof-of-existence certificate with a public page.

features.title: Check a proof
features.blurb: Confirm on chain that a fingerprint was anchored, and when.
